capabilities: Open PDFs linked in the bibliography via the PDF++ plugin
Watch the bib file and re-parse it automatically in the background
Resolve bdsk-file macOS bookmarks to files that were renamed or moved
Use libraries stored outside the vault, including multi-GB collections
disambiguation: Not limited to BibDesk; it works with any standard BibTeX library, though some features like bdsk-file fields are macOS BibDesk-specific.
extras: Installation is manual and involved: cloning, building with Node.js and a Swift compiler, and copying dist files into the vault. Docs elsewhere: none stated.
intentEvidence: Unlike most BibTeX plugins for Obsidian, this plugin is designed to handle large libraries with 10,000+ papers
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to parse large external BibTeX bibliography files and open the PDFs they reference, especially files stored outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Integration with PDF++: Opens PDFs stored outside your Obsidian vault via the PDF++ plugin.
some features are designed specifically for libraries maintained with BibDesk on macOS

summary: Integrates external BibTeX libraries, including BibDesk libraries, with Obsidian and the PDF++ plugin to import citations and open linked PDFs.
